name: TM7 Ultimate Olive Oil Roast Potatoes
ingredients: 1000 g Maris Piper or King Edward potatoes
1200 g water, plus extra for peeling if using Peeler mode
1 1/2 tsp fine salt, plus extra to finish

steps.text: Peel 1000 g potatoes and cut into chunky roast-potato pieces, roughly 4-5 cm. If using the TM7 Blade Cover & Peeler, peel in 2 batches of 500 g potatoes, using 600 g water for each batch and Peeler mode. Drain and rinse after peeling.
Preheat the oven to 210°C fan. Place a large heavy metal roasting tray in the oven so it gets thoroughly hot.

Fit the Blade Cover & Peeler securely over the mixing knife. Add the 1000 g prepared potatoes, 1200 g water, 1 1/2 tsp fine salt and 1/2 tsp bicarbonate of soda. Make sure the contents do not exceed the maximum fill level.

Cook using Slow Cook mode / 98°C / 25 minutes. Check the potatoes: the outer edges should be tender and beginning to soften while the pieces still hold together. If they are still very firm, cook for a further 5 minutes at 98°C using Slow Cook mode.

Carefully drain the potatoes using the Varoma dish or a large colander. Leave them to steam-dry for 5 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl or dry saucepan and shake them firmly a few times to rough up the edges. The fluffy, battered-looking edges will become the crispy crust.
Add 80 g olive oil to the hot roasting tray and return the tray to the oven for 5 minutes so the oil is properly hot.
Carefully add the roughened potatoes to the hot oil. Turn each piece so it is coated all over, spread into a single layer and roast at 210°C fan for 25 minutes.
Turn the potatoes and roast for a further 20 minutes at 210°C fan.
Turn the potatoes again. Add 4 lightly crushed garlic cloves and 2-3 sprigs fresh rosemary or thyme, then roast for a final 15-20 minutes until deeply golden and extremely crisp.
Remove from the oven, season immediately with extra fine salt and black pepper to taste, then serve while piping hot and crisp.
